document.name: Wave Hill — Family Art Project
document.shortDescription: Weekend drop-in family art at Wave Hill House in Riverdale, with most Saturdays and Sundays 10 a.m.–1 p.m. and first/third-Saturday storytime at 11:30 a.m.
document.longDescription:
Wave Hill's Family Art Project page says this inter-generational program invites families to make art inspired by nature, science, and culture on site at Wave Hill House. The official page lists the core schedule as Saturday and Sunday, 10AM-1PM, and says onsite drop-in programs run most Saturdays and Sundays with no preregistration required.

The same page says the program is free with admission and best suited for children and their families. It also lists an affiliated storytime at 11:30AM on the first and third Saturday of every month, described as a free drop-in session designed to appeal to children of all ages. A Wave Hill calendar entry for May 2-3, 2026 confirms the published 10:00AM-1:00PM weekend timing and notes that registration is not required.

Wave Hill's getting-here page places the venue in the Riverdale section of the Bronx at 4900 Independence Avenue. The visit page lists Tuesday-Sunday grounds hours, a published child admission price of $4 for ages 6+, and free admission on Thursdays; because Family Art Project itself is weekend-only, the stored day/time tags reflect the program schedule rather than general grounds hours.

Sources: https://www.wavehill.org/education/children-and-families/the-family-art-project https://www.wavehill.org/calendar/family-art-project-portraits-of-home https://www.wavehill.org/visit/getting-here https://www.wavehill.org/visit?gad_source=1
